- Removed `xunit.runner.visualstudio` and `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk` (no longer needed — v3 has a built-in runner)
- Updated `Xunit.Combinatorial` 1.6.24 → 2.1.23-alpha (v3-compatible)
- Updated `Xunit.StaFact` 1.1.11 → 4.0.5-beta (v3-compatible)

**`global.json`:** Removed `"runner": "VSTest"` (v3 doesn't use VSTest)

**`CombinatorialTests.cs`:** No changes needed — the API (`[Theory]`, `[CombinatorialData]`, `[StaFact]`, `Assert`) is source-compatible.
